title: O Autumn
preview:
In autumn's tender, humble fall,
A quiet grandeur cloaks it all.
Leaves in gold and crimson blaze,
Awakening hearts in a fleeting haze.

No sorrow in fall, they drift, they lift,

title: Meet me there
preview:
Not here, where words are made
for weather and for small talks
where we ask how are you and never mean it
and answer fine — Means nothing

Meet me there -
past the small talk and the careful smiles,
past the version of myself
I keep presentable for society

title: The Paradox of All Knowledge
preview:
We built a library with infinite shelves
and then we built walls inside it.
The algorithm learned our taste
the way a mirror learns your face,
by reflecting it endlessly

title: The Alchemy of Waiting
preview:
In the space between the want and the arrival,
something ancient stirs.
Not yet, but almost—
this is where the real work happens.
The caterpillar waits patiently in its cocoon,

title: I am contagious
preview:
I have slept in the skulls for decades
curled beneath centuries of silence.
patient as stone, quiet as dead —
waiting for one mind to catch my violence.
I outlasted Galileo's dungeon walls.

title: Law & Morality
preview:
If morality shapes law,
then whose hand writes the code of right?
Whose whims win?
The saint's prayer, the tyrant's will,
or the crowd that changes with the night?

title: OH ! The paradox of Union
preview:
The snake's skin that once kept winter out
will choke it in spring if never shed.
The armor forged for yesterday's war
becomes a cage, turns to living dread.
A mind that nails itself to stone,

title: Unchanged, We Break
preview:
The snake's skin that once kept winter out
will choke it in spring if never shed.
The armor forged for yesterday's war
becomes a cage, turns to living dread.
A mind that nails itself to stone,

title: Security through Obscurity
preview:
I built my silences carefully,
layer over layer,
like mortar covering a wall that cracks in every rain.
You call it secrecy,
but it's only way out.

title: Men
preview:
In the house where men have sat,
with their arms open,
receiving nothing,
the walls have learned to keep secrets.
The ceiling knows more confessions

title: Purpose
preview:
We are the only animals who die twice—
once when the life ends
once in the panic that it meant nothing.
The second death is the expensive one.
Seminars. Retreats. Spiritual shops

title: The Shrine of emptiness
preview:
In the middle of my haste to arrive somewhere acceptable,
I saw a glint in the dark street
I bent down quickly, almost relieved.
I lifted a crumpled wrapper, mistaking reflection for value,
Mistaking borrowed light

title: Tongue and ear
preview:
Why is it that a bite connects,
But verses build a wall?
Why can my mouth enjoy a buffet
Yet ears can't decipher it all?
A taco requires no syntax,

title: Letter to a city I never learned to love
preview:
I never learned the name of the street
that smelled of rain and diesel and almost —
but I memorised its absence.

title: Hydrogen & oxygen — a Jungian paradox
preview:
Hydrogen burns.
Oxygen feeds the burning.
Together they become the thing
that puts out fires.

title: Ideas are contagious (in the way of fever)
preview:
You gave it to me mid-sentence,
the way the sick give warmth —
without meaning to, without knowing.

title: The man who concealed his softness
preview:
He learned early:
the wound you name
becomes the wound they own.

title: Cheeku, at dawn
preview:
You asked me where the sun goes
when it rains —
and I did not say: everywhere.

title: After reading Dostoevsky at midnight
preview:
His characters suffer
loudly, in long sentences —
a luxury I have not permitted myself.
